channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Collision on N22 Farran
item.description: Reports of a collision (overturned vehicle) on the N22 near Ballineadig/Farran. Emergency services are on scene. Take care on approach.

item.title: Broken-down Vehicle on M8 Northbound
item.description: Reports of a broken-down vehicle, northbound, on the M8 Dublin Motorway between Junction 12 (N73) Mitchelstown (North) and Junction 11 Cahir (South) (6 kilometres south of the Cahir area). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 3 March at 14:15.

item.title: Breakdown on N22 Westbound
item.description: Reports of a breakdown, westbound, on the N22 between R584 Coolcower and R582 Gurteenroe (near Macroom). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 3 March at 16:56.

item.title: An Garda Síochána Seeks Public Views on Drone and Aerial Recording Devices
item.description: An Garda Síochána is seeking public feedback on a draft Code of Practice for aerial recording devices, including drones. Submissions close 31 March 2026.

item.title: Collision on R589 Crossbarry
item.description: Reports of a collision on the R589 Crossbarry near the petrol station. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Collision at Shannonpark
item.description: Reports of a collision near Shannonpark/Shannonpark Roundabout. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Ireland Activates Charter Flight Plan to Evacuate Vulnerable Citizens from UAE
item.description: Ireland is arranging a charter flight from Oman Airport for vulnerable Irish citizens in the UAE. Contact your nearest Irish Embassy if you need assistance.

item.title: Pedestrian Knocked Down Andersons Quay
item.description: Reports a pedestrian has been knocked down on Andersons Quay, near the entrance to the Simon Community. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Ireland Moves to Crack Down on Vapes, Nicotine Pouches & Novel Nicotine Products
item.description: Ireland is set to ban nicotine pouches for under-18s and crack down on vape advertising under new legislation approved by Government.

item.title: Two Men Charged After €12,600 Drug Seizure in Bantry
item.description: Gardaí charge two men after €12,600 drug seizure in Bantry, as part of Operation Tara's ongoing crackdown on drug supply networks.
